channel.title: Projects on Simon Philp
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Simon Philp

item.title: Embedding Alignment for Profile Matching
item.description: An exploration of techniques for aligning distinct embedding spaces to improve profile matching and unified identity resolution in privacy-first, cookieless environments.

item.title: Are Open-Source Embedding Models Good Enough?
item.description: A comparative study analyzing the performance, cost, and privacy of open-source embedding models against proprietary APIs in enterprise environments.

item.title: Can Machine Learning Beat the Bookies?
item.description: Built a machine learning model to predict football matches, tested it against bookies, and even made a small profit—all powered by data and curiosity.

item.title: Creating a Notes Chatbot
item.description: I used the OpenAI Agents SDK to build a personal chatbot that reads and responds based on my notes. Streamlit handles the UI, making it easy to chat with my knowledge in real time.

item.title: Extreme Rainfall Modelling
item.description: My master’s dissertation investigating using Bayesian Additive Regression Trees (BART) to model extreme rainfall across Nepal. This work was completed in associated with the MetOffice.
